application_method.details: Apply at the post covering your registered residence (or your last school). Hanoi: Korea Visa Application Center Hanoi (Discovery Building 12F, 302 Cau Giay; www.visaforkorea-vt.com; fee 390,000 VND); agencies in the jurisdiction may file D-2/D-4 since 2025-10-20. HCMC: KVAC HCMC (253 Dien Bien Phu; www.visaforkorea-hc.com; 390,000 VND). Da Nang: book online at g4k.go.kr, then visit the consulate in person (no proxy for study visas). reviewer_notes: Two official embassy sources disagree on amount (USD 20,000 vs 18,000 for D-2; 10,000 vs 9,000 for D-4) and TB validity (6 vs 3 months). The Russian page is undated but appears newer. Until an embassy officer confirms, show both figures and send students to the embassy to confirm. If only one number can be shown, the higher amount and the shorter TB validity are the safe choice. Processing time is not stated.
